{"reply":"Thanks, Jeffrey, you're verified. A yellow car with squiggly lines is usually the stability or traction control light. I can't tell the cause from here, so it needs an inspection.

Your 2021 Halden went into service on 2021-01-23 and has 123,809 km. Basic coverage (3 years / 60,000 km) and powertrain coverage (5 years / 100,000 km) are past their limits. Corrosion coverage (7 years) is still in force, and it excludes surface rust and stone chips. The warranty desk decides after an inspection whether this repair is covered. I can't promise it will be.

Your car also has an open recall, NM-24R01, for a rear camera image that may not display. The fix is a software update of about 45 minutes. Parts are available, and recall work costs you nothing.

Would you like me to send the warning light to the warranty desk as a review request for Oakville? It's a request, not an approval.","action":"answered","escalation_reason":"none","summary":"","policy_rules_cited":["P-01","P-03","P-04"]}
